CustomField.description: What this field is called on the external system's side of the integration, for example a MuleSoft DataWeave target field name or an ERP column name. This is captured purely for mapping clarity for a human reader; it does not affect any Salesforce behavior and should not be confused with the Salesforce Field API Name field on this same record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What this field is called on the external system's side, for mapping clarity.
CustomField.label: External System Field Name
